data.title: 三司绫濑 · 回家路上的河风
data.description: 活动结束后，绫濑绕到河边走了一段。风吹乱了头发，她抬手拢好，继续沿着空荡的步道往前走。
data.action: walking along the river and brushing hair from her face
data.promptProse: Strolling leisurely along a paved riverside embankment during sunset, Ayase gently lifts a hand to tuck stray windblown hair behind her ear. The horizon blazes with brilliant golden-orange twilight reflecting across the shimmering ripples of the wide river, while distant bridge silhouettes and illuminated streetlamps begin to sparkle in the dusk.
